column1: # Tests this port is EXPECTED to fail, and why. Read by balticporter.tir.Correlate; a test listed
# here is reported as expected rather than as a regression, and one that starts PASSING is reported
# too, because a substitution that began working is news.
# This is per-library POLICY (CLAUDE.md §1c) and therefore DATA: nothing in `core` may name a
# ported library, so the engine cannot know that `Json.fromJson` is deliberately absent. When
# LIBRARY-READINESS.md §1.2's `PortRun` lands it should GENERATE this file from the port's own
# `Substitutions` — a test whose stack reaches a dropped type is expected by construction — and
# this hand-written form becomes the fallback for failures a manifest cannot predict.
# `test` may be `*` to declare a whole suite.

column3: Substitutions.dropTypes com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Json — the injected replacement throws until a codec is bound (sge replaces the reflection-based Json with Kindlings Jsoniter/UBJson)
